verdict.rationale: Google Cloud offers agent-building services (Vertex AI), so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows only Google-published MCP servers that external clients connect to: the Cloud Run MCP server and MCP Toolbox for Databases. That is the server role and does not show Google Cloud plugging in third-party MCP servers to use their tools. The Vertex AI 'agentic systems' marketing never mentions MCP client support.
